name: Hanabi Matsuri
description: A kinetic, poster-like theme for summer fireworks and music festivals and town event organisers, set like a Japanese festival poster: enormous condensed capitals, oversized date numerals, sunburst rays turning slowly behind the type, slanted orange bands, crossing ribbons that scroll, notched ticket cards and a lineup set biggest names first; with a three-night timetable for two stages, the fireworks running order, lineup tiles, pass tiers with a seat plan and a pre-registration form (no payment), a festival map, transport and FAQ, in deep summer-night indigo with fireworks vermilion-orange, marigold, paper-lantern cream and a single electric magenta spark.

fonts.role: poster titles, date numerals and the lineup
